hero.heading: Our Services & Products
hero.subheading: From purpose-built dialysis tools to secure care portals for doctors and patients — Srimae delivers intelligent healthcare products for every need.

clinicalServices.heading: Doctor & Patient Portals
clinicalServices.subheading: Two focused portals — Doctor Portal for clinical documents, and Patient Portal for everyday health tracking (migraine, BP, medications, checkup records) — completely separate from dialysis care.

items.title: Doctor Portal
items.description: A secure document vault for doctors — store, organize, and review structured or unstructured clinical documents separate from the dialysis patient app.

items.title: Patient Portal
items.description: For general patients — track medications, headache/migraine diary, BP vitals, and regular health records for common conditions, independent of dialysis.

dialysisApp.heading: Dialysis Companion App
dialysisApp.subheading: Already Live and improving quality of life for dialysis patients every day. Our app gives patients and care teams a complete picture of what matters most.

features.title: Potassium Tracking
features.description: Log and monitor potassium levels with trend analysis to stay within safe clinical ranges.

features.title: Protein Monitoring
features.description: Track daily protein intake to support muscle health and meet dialysis dietary requirements.

features.title: Intradialytic Fluid Tracking
features.description: Record fluid intake during dialysis sessions for accurate clinical review.

features.title: Interdialytic Weight Gain
features.description: Monitor fluid accumulation between sessions to reduce complications and hospitalizations.

features.title: Nutrition Diary
features.description: A full food and nutrition log tailored to the specific dietary needs of dialysis patients.

features.title: Medical Diary
features.description: Document symptoms, medications, and clinical notes in one organized, shareable record.

features.title: Smart Reports & Charts
features.description: Auto-generated visual reports that give clinicians and patients clear, actionable health trends.
